messages:
julie_w: quick heads-up — seeing truncated streaming responses when we use IHttpClientFactory + Polly retries on the new embeddings client.

julie_w: stack: net7, using named HttpClient from DI, calling client.GetAsync(url) then response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync() and streaming to caller.

julie_w: symptom: clients sometimes get half the JSON then the stream closes, no exception logged. thought it was a read bug but repro is consistent when a retry happens.

samir: can you paste the minimal code? often it's ResponseHeadersRead vs default.

julie_w: here's the snippet:
```
var resp = await httpClient.GetAsync(url); // default
using var stream = await resp.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync();
await stream.CopyToAsync(outStream, cancellationToken);
```

samir: try:
```
var resp = await httpClient.GetAsync(url, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, cancellationToken);
resp.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
using var stream = await resp.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(cancellationToken);
await stream.CopyToAsync(outStream, 81920, cancellationToken);
```
ResponseHeadersRead ensures the handler doesn't buffer the entire body — also avoid reading resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync.

mike_t: +1. Also: Polly by default will retry the whole handler call. If you retry after partially reading a streamed response you can drop the underlying connection or get weird semantics. Best practice: don't apply retries at the call site that returns a live Stream. Either:
- return a buffered response (read into Memory/TempFile) before retry, or
- scope retries to status codes/exceptions that happen before body streaming starts, or
- disable retries for that named HttpClient.

mike_t: example Policy: 
```
// only retry on network exceptions or 5xx before body read
Policy<HttpResponseMessage> retry = Policy
  .Handle<HttpRequestException>()
  .OrResult<HttpResponseMessage>(r => (int)r.StatusCode >= 500)
  .RetryAsync(2);
```
But don't wrap the stream consumer with retries.

samir: also check SocketsHttpHandler.PooledConnectionLifetime and MaxConnectionsPerServer. If a connection is dropped mid-stream and a retry tries to reuse it weirdness can happen. We set:
```
services.AddHttpClient("embeddings")
  .ConfigurePrimaryHttpMessageHandler(() => new SocketsHttpHandler {
    PooledConnectionLifetime = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
    MaxConnectionsPerServer = 100
  });
```

olivia: small logistics — julie, can you attach the failing trace + the PR link? I'll pair with you after standup. Also pinging @mike_t for a quick CR on #4567.

julie_w: CI says integration tests flaky but reproducer attached: /tmp/repro.tar.gz and PR #4567.

deploy-bot: CI / integration-tests — passed :white_check_mark:

mike_t: I'll review #4567 in ~45m. If we can't get a clear fix we should disable automatic retries on that client and add a note in the SDK docs about streaming + Polly.

julie_w: thanks — doing a small PR to set ResponseHeadersRead + disable retry policy on the named client for now. will update here when merged.

samir: fyi, add a comment in SDK README about streaming semantics and example code. saves future debugging.

julie_w: will do. thanks all :rocket:
